Apple reports fourth quarter results

Record September quarter revenue of $102.5 billion, up 8 percent year over year. Quarterly diluted earnings per share of $1.85, up 13 percent year over year.

CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA — Apple today announced financial results for its fiscal 2026 fourth quarter ended September 27, 2026. The Company posted quarterly revenue of $102.5 billion, up 8 percent year over year, and quarterly diluted earnings per share of $1.85, up 13 percent year over year.

Apple’s board of directors has declared a cash dividend of $0.27 per share of the Company’s common stock.
